annotations.title: Price a design for my shop

description: For a marketplace design (from search_designs) or a staged model, quotes what print shops charge to make it, the platform fee and royalty, and the retail price that leaves a chosen margin. Use it before suggesting a price. Returns the page to create the listing. Each quote lists the materials and colors that shop offers; pass material and color to quote one of them. With several shops quoted, each material shows a few colors and how many there are; pass shop to list them all. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

color.description: Quote this color, by hex (#1A1A1A) or name. Shops without it quote their default color.

design_id.description: A design id from search_designs, or a staged model id (file_...)

finish.description: With color: the finish to prefer when a shop has that color in more than one, for example matte or glossy

margin_percent.description: Profit as a percent of the retail price

material.description: Quote this material, for example PLA or PETG. Shops without it are left out.

part_colors.description: For a model with several parts: a color per part, in the quoted material. Each shop prints a part in that color when it has it, else its closest. Parts left out print in the quoted color. Shops that cannot print the colors together are left out.

color.description: The color for this part, by hex or name. Left out, the part prints in the quoted color

shop.description: Quote one print shop (id or handle). Otherwise up to three shops are quoted.
